name: ai-frontier-provider
description: Offline-first Martian AI Frontier observations for model-aware consumers.

interface.shortDescription: Offline snapshots of public model-quality and cost observations.
interface.longDescription: Consumes only selected public JSON endpoints from Martian AI Frontier after an explicit local personal-use opt-in. It preserves a local last-known-good snapshot, never logs in or sends cookies, and never represents local consent as publisher authorization.
defaultPrompt: Show the local AI Frontier provider status.
Explain the AI Frontier personal-use consent boundary.
Show the latest local AI Frontier observation snapshot.
